title: FY27 NYC Business Solution Center Negotiated Acquisition Extension - Brooklyn
agency_path: City of New York > Small Business Services
description_text:
The New York City Department of Small Business Services is entering into a Negotiated Acquisition Extension contract with Brooklyn Alliance Inc to provide a suite of business services in Brooklyn that include but are not limited to financing awards, recruitment, training, business education, Minority/Women Business Enterprise certification assistance, other business service referrals including governmental resources and delivering customer service in the multiple languages to serve the diverse populations in the City.  In addition to increasing businesses and entrepreneurs' knowledge and awareness of other available City programs.

This will allow the agency to extend the current contract with the existing vendor to continue support businesses and entrepreneurs in Brooklyn, Boro-wide. The term will be from 7/1/2026 to 6/30/2027, in the amount of $578,914.00, EPIN: 80127N0006.

Vendors interested in responding to future solicitations for these types of services should contact Dolly Del Rosario at procurementhelpdesk@sbs.nyc.gov.
